intro.text: A city built into a deep chasm that opens onto the Sea of Spears, in Alethkar.
A former city in the north of the Eastern Crownlands, also called the Rift, home to tens of thousands of people until it was burnt to the ground in 1163.

description.text: The city lay in a V-shaped canyon at least 150 feet deep that narrows at one end and opens onto the Sea of Spears at the other. From the flat, rocky land above, it was hard to see, and a wall enclosed the opening on every side but the west.
It stood on the eastern shore of the Sea of Spears, near the Thanadal and Kholin princedoms. A nearby riverbed fills only during storms, because huge rockbuds, some nine feet tall, drink its water.
Rathalas was built in tiers on struts up the chasm walls, reached by ramps from the plain above or from the canyon mouth below. Its people, sometimes called Rifters, have a distinct nasal accent.

items.text: Gavilar Kholin besieged Rathalas while uniting the princedoms. Dalinar sought out and killed Brightlord Tanalan, winning the Shardblade Oathbringer, but disobeyed orders and spared Tanalan's young heir, who fled with his mother.

Years later, Tanalan's son, also named Tanalan, returned and demanded his father's Blade. Unrest spread through the Eastern Crownlands, and Gavilar's attempts to settle it by politics failed, partly because another highprince backed the rebels.

After twelve years, Dalinar and Sadeas returned to end the rebellion. Urged by his wife, Dalinar offered Tanalan a last chance to submit, but Tanalan used the truce to lure him into a trap. Dalinar survived and ordered the city razed and its people slaughtered, and Tanalan was killed after watching his family die.
Evi Kholin died in the city during the battle, having gone there secretly to plead for its surrender. A story was spread that her assassination had prompted the slaughter, hiding how she really died.
